description: Curated evaluation set for the TeachBack answer evaluator. Each item is a hypothetical short student answer to a question about one concept, labelled with the evidence level a teacher would assign: strong (demonstrates the concept), partial (part of it / one important fact missing), unclear (vague, off-topic, or no evidence), or misconception (contradicts the taught material; 'misconception' names the expected teacher-authored misconception). Items were written by hand to cover textbook wording, paraphrases, simple/informal language, short answers, analogies, noise, and answers that deliberately avoid the reference terminology. This set does NOT represent real student populations; it is used to tune thresholds and prevent regressions.
